description: Prepare ONE private message to an event host or a community, not an event RSVP. Supply eventId or collectiveId (exactly one; a community-owned event routes to its community either way), stable requestId, explicit replyEmail, message and topic question/tickets/refund/volunteering/accessibility/collaboration, or topic community for a community page. Use only facts the person wants included, never private memories/transcripts by default. Returns the exact message, recipient label, email-sharing disclosure, requestId and reviewHash. Sends nothing. In SocialLoop chat, immediately stage send_host_contact alone with these returned values; the system shows the exact review and collects one approval. Do not ask a separate informal confirmation first. Draft expires in 30 minutes; changed content or a confirmed expired draft needs a new requestId.
name: prepare_host_contact
title: Prepare Host Contact
